payload.title: Preserve sequential Lua tables as host arrays
payload.description:
As a host integration author, I want sequential Lua tables to cross registered Python module calls as ordered lists, so typed host contracts receive their documented values.

Feature: Host module table conversion

  Scenario: Convert a sequential Lua table
    Given a registered host function receives a Lua table with keys one through N
    When Tactus invokes the Python function
    Then the argument is an ordered Python list
    And nested sequential tables are also lists

  Scenario: Preserve mapping tables
    Given a Lua table contains named or sparse keys
    When Tactus invokes the Python function
    Then the argument remains a mapping with every entry

Out of scope: host-specific validation or product-specific behavior.
